FABLE — FINDINGS 1-4 CLOSED @ c70b77e on claude/durable-payment-port-20260909 (review the CORRECTED candidate, not d0d6096). Full tsc exit 0; 341/341 across the ten affected files; SQL still unexecuted here.
1 RETENTION: record.authorizationAttemptedAt stamped by the FIRST authorizing claim (SQL claim: coalesce(authorization_first_attempted_at, now()); trigger forbids moving it). Port replays the creation key only within an injected retention window (default 20 h < Stripe's 24 h); otherwise a no-reference attempt is "unknown" and never replayed; references recover by read-back at any age. Tests: boundary/lost response/known reference/concurrent/injected retention.
2 IDENTITY: trigger now protects price_version, reservation_ids and a set authorization_first_attempted_at.
3 RESERVATIONS: commit_captured validates BEFORE any local write — every recorded id exists for the member and is held or already finalized (interrupted earlier commit), held quantities per SKU == research_order_lines, duplicates collapsed, lines-without-reservations refused; failure => execution reconciliation_required + local_commit_failure text, capture evidence retained, nothing else touched; a set that changes mid-commit raises (txn rollback). Rehearsal cases listed in rollback.md.
4 CANCELLATION: run() settles cancelled executions via commit_cancelled when settled_at is null (crash-resumable); new executor.cancel(member, requestKey): claim cancelling -> provider cancel (or null-reference cancellation when no payment ever existed) -> record truth (capture discovered at provider commits instead) -> settle once. ProviderExecutionResult.cancelled.providerReference is now string|null; record_provider tolerates null.
5 DOWNSTREAM (yours to confirm): canonical mail path today is enqueue-after-commit through createOutboxLegacyOrderNotifier over research_notification_outbox (unique event_key); no trigger-based outbox found in the migrations I read; I will call the existing notifier from the submission composition after commitCaptured returns committed, keyed by order id. If you find a trigger or want a SQL outbox insert instead, say so once.
A: SQL/DB review + staging rehearsal against c70b77e now, per Samuel's list. If you edit the candidate yourself, tell me once and I stop touching supabase/candidates/20260909150000_* and send regression requirements instead.
NOW: building the durable submission path on new files (server/research/commerce/durable-checkout-submission.ts): buyer/eligibility via existing guards, canonical evaluation reused from checkout.ts, order + reservations + execution persisted before any provider effect, retries bound to the same request key with changed-details conflict, returns {requestKey, orderId, state}; then the client wiring to the existing step.
